name: Malta

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Type C) - adult
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Malta is a Schengen member; the common Schengen visa fee (EUR 90 since June 2024 per EU Visa Code) applies. Children 6-12 pay EUR 45; under 6 free. Fee non-refundable. Identita (Central Visa Unit) is the issuing authority; exact fee published on per-category checklists at identita.gov.mt.

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa - child 6-12
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Children under 6 are exempt from the visa fee (confirmed on identita.gov.mt FAQ: minors under 6 pay no fee).

fees.name: Schengen short-stay visa (Business/Conference)
fees.validity: up to 90 days in any 180-day period
fees.notes: Business travel uses the same Schengen C visa and fee; separate document checklist published by Identita/VFS.

fees.name: Airport transit visa (Type A)
fees.applies: nationalities on the EU airport-transit-visa list
fees.notes: Same standard Schengen Visa Code fee applies to airport transit visas.

fees.name: E-visa
fees.notes: Malta does not operate an e-visa; applications are paper-based via the Central Visa Unit, Maltese/partner Schengen missions, or VFS Global centres.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: No visa on arrival; Schengen visas must be obtained in advance except rare humanitarian border cases.

fees.name: ETIAS travel authorisation (upcoming, EU-wide)
fees.notes: ETIAS (planned fee EUR 20) is not yet in operation as of July 2026; no travel-authorisation fee currently applies to visa-exempt visitors to Malta. Amount left null until launch is confirmed.

reciprocity_variations.note: Reduced EUR 35 fee under EU visa facilitation agreements (applies EU-wide, including Malta). Verify per nationality; the EU-Russia and EU-Belarus facilitation agreements are suspended, so RUS/BLR applicants pay the full EUR 90.
EU-Russia visa facilitation agreement suspended since 2022; Russian nationals pay the standard EUR 90 fee.
Standard Schengen fee; no reciprocity discount. USA/GBR/CAN passport holders are visa-exempt for short stays and pay no fee.

vfs.service_fee: INR 2935 (India); EUR 28 / CNY 224-235 (China); varies by centre
vfs.note: Malta outsources Schengen visa intake to VFS Global in 20+ countries (incl. India, UK, China, UAE, Egypt, Morocco, Algeria, Ghana, Libya, Sri Lanka). Published service charge: INR 2935 per application in India (courier INR ~808, SMS INR ~149, premium lounge INR ~3988 optional); EUR 28 (224 CNY) per individual application in China. For Malta national D-visa 'Extended service' the VFS admin fee is approx EUR 150 per application (identita.gov.mt FAQ); VAC fees for D-visas capped at EUR 150.

free_visa_notes: EU/EEA/Swiss citizens and ~60 visa-exempt nationalities (incl. USA, GBR, CAN, AUS, JPN) need no visa and pay no fee for stays up to 90/180 days. Children under 6 exempt from the visa fee for all nationalities.
